title: Business Modelling
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement that communicates the unique value and benefits your business offers to your target customers."
A value proposition is a statement that communicates the unique value and benefits your business offers to your target customers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a critical aspect of a business's success, as it directly impacts revenue and profitability."
Setting the right price is a critical aspect of a business's success, as it directly impacts revenue and profitability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of gathering and analysing information about your target market to make informed business decisions."
Market research is the process of gathering and analysing information about your target market to make informed business decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of dividing a broad target market into smaller, more manageable segments."
Market segmentation is the process of dividing a broad target market into smaller, more manageable segments.
fib: ______ is the core of a successful business because: i.
Fulfilling one's customers' needs is the core of a successful business because: i.
______ is the foundation for creating a sustainable and valuable business.
Understanding and solving customer problems is the foundation for creating a sustainable and valuable business.
______ is a strategic management tool that serves as a visual framework for developing, describing, and analysing a business model.
The Business Model Canvas is a strategic management tool that serves as a visual framework for developing, describing, and analysing a business model.
